profile.headline: Team leader plans team tasks to accomplish organizational goals and manages resources to efficiently employ team.  Testing expert reviews user guides, requirement specifications, and interface control documentation.
profile.summary: Team leader plans team tasks to accomplish organizational goals and manages resources to efficiently employ team assets.  Testing expert reviews user guides, requirement specifications, and interface control documentation to devise extensive manual and automated tests to thoroughly verify the operational functionality of tested software.  Network modeler configures virtual machines, networks, switches, and controllers to model network to test system integration and user interface designs.  Bachelor’s degree in computer science.  Studying for a Master’s degree in Cybersecurity Technology.

positions.title: Office of Information Technology Spartan Tech
positions.description:
The duties performed by Spartan Tech include:

-Imaging and deployment of Windows PCs
-Trouble shooting and repair of faculty Windows PCs and Macs
-Technical support for student network configurations for computers, gaming systems and phones.
-Password reset
-Office software

positions.title: Summer Program Research Intern
positions.description:
• Researched the usage of cognitive radio for more efficient employment of the radio spectrum.
• Developed a Python program that converts spectrum analyzer wide spectrum data into a three dimensional model for preliminary evaluation.
• Coordinated the Cyber-security, Communications & Networking Innovation Summer Workshop to promote STEM careers to Hampton Roads high school students.

positions.title: Instructor/Surface Warfare Trainer
positions.description:
•	Developed and applied training topics and combat scenarios for teams of up to 50 sailors for conducting routine Operations Center tasking, enforcement of national maritime strategy and execution of effective war-fighting techniques.  
•	Advised the Commanding Officer (CEO) on matters pertaining to drug and alcohol policy as it applied to personnel, training, disciple and rehabilitation.   
•	Developed and maintained company drug and alcohol prevention program; monitoring 250 records to ensure all personnel receive required, as well as, recommended training; arranged screening and treatment for any employee who was suspected of having a substance abuse problem.  Provided support and information to victims of sexual assaults in the form of crisis intervention and referrals; after an incident - secured basic needs such as clothing to wear to and from the hospital and arranged transportation; accompanied victims to interviews, trials and court hearings; minimized the effects of re-victimization of the sexual assault victims.

positions.title: Assistant Schedules Officer
positions.description:
•	Reviewed and approved proposed schedules for 60 ships operating in the Seventh Fleet Area of Responsibility (25 permanently assigned/35 visiting).  
•	Coordinated between State Department and foreign governmental agencies to arrange diplomatic clearance for United States Naval vessels to visit ports in countries including Korea, China and Russia.  
•	Managed a 200 million dollar fuel budget for the Commander of the US Seventh Fleet.  Reported the consumption of fuel based on planned naval exercises, missions and contingent operations such as the tsunami relief operations of 2004.  
•	Supervised a 15-person Global Command and Control System team to provide 24 hour 7 day a week real time information about all military and merchant shipping operation in the 7th Fleet area of responsibility

positions.title: Leading Petty Office
positions.description:
•	Trained and supervised 18-person division to gather, process and disseminate all information obtained by shipboard sensors to provide local and national commanders with a complete tactical picture.  
•	Trained and performed organizational and intermediate level maintenance on radar repeaters and all associated equipment.

positions.title: Briefing Coordinator
positions.description:
•	Revised all command briefs using Microsoft office automation to ensure all briefs had the most current data.  
•	Coordinated flag officer briefs for the Commander of Naval Forces Atlantic.  
•	Implemented Access Database to manage the 256 subscriber identifiers for the Officer in Tactical Command Information Exchange System (OTCIXS) satellite network to ensure efficient and effective use of the limited satellite spectrum.
